description: PERSIST benchmark settings on the device so they stick across runs. Only use when the user explicitly wants to save a change ("always", "save this"). For a one-off, pass overrides to run_benchmark_batch instead — don't change their saved profile.

captureRenders.description: Capture per-component render counts/durations during each run.

deviceId.description: The device to act on: its id from list_devices or from your instructions. Pass it whenever more than one app may be connected. Once a call names a device, later calls in this session use it when deviceId is left out.

discardWarmupRuns.description: Discard first N runs of each page before the median.

navTimeoutMs.description: Max wait for navigation per run (ms).

reloadBetweenCases.description: Fully reload JS between pages (needs <AutomationResumer/> mounted).

runsPerCase.description: Runs per page; median is the canonical result (1–10).

shuffleCases.description: Interleave and shuffle case order to reduce order-related bias.

name: set_benchmark_settings
